d: Crowne Plaza Muscat OCEC is a distinguished five-star hotel located within the iconic Oman Convention and Exhibition Centre in Muscat. Combining modern luxury with traditional Omani hospitality, the hotel offers exceptional accommodation, world-class dining, and state-of-the-art meeting and event facilities. As a preferred destination for business travellers, conference delegates, and leisure guests, Crowne Plaza Muscat OCEC prides itself on delivering personalized service, innovative experiences, and seamless connectivity. Strategically positioned in Oman’s vibrant capital, it serves as a gateway to the region’s cultural heritage and burgeoning business landscape.

r: The Assistant Marketing Manager will support development, execution, and optimisation of marketing strategies designed to enhance brand awareness, grow revenue from rooms, food & beverage, events & conferences, and to ensure consistent alignment with IHG / Crowne Plaza brand standards. This role requires both creative and analytical skills, strong cross‐departmental collaboration, and a proactive mind-set to respond to market trends, competitor activity, and evolving guest expectations
Assist in developing the annual and quarterly marketing plans, aligned with hotel objectives
Help manage and monitor the marketing budget; track spend vs ROI and suggest reallocations when needed
Support forecasting of marketing campaign outcomes
Oversee the hotel’s digital footprint: website content, SEO/SEM optimization, online travel agency (OTA) listings
Plan and execute social media strategies across platforms (Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn etc.), including content calendars, posts, ad campaigns
Coordinate email marketing campaigns, display advertising, retargeting and online promotions
Manage production of digital assets: photos, videos, graphics, ensuring alignment with brand standards
Launch marketing campaigns in support of rooms, F&B, events & meetings; measure their effectiveness
Use analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Social Media Insights, Meta Ads, etc.) to monitor performance, draw insights, report, and optimize
Prepare KPI reports for the senior management and recommend improvements
Develop PR strategies; maintain media relations; write & distribute press releases
Organize media visits, site inspections, familiarization trips
Ensure brand consistency across all touchpoints—print, digital, environmental, signage etc.
Support seasonal promotions, collateral design, signage, merchandise
Participate in trade shows, exhibitions, local partnerships, and promotions
Collaborate with third‐party agencies/vendors when needed (design, PR, media buying etc.)
Support internal communications to employees regarding marketing campaigns, hotel positioning etc.
Monitor local, GCC, and international market trends; understand customer segmentation, guest preferences
Track competitor activity, rate offerings, promotions, brand positioning
Use insight to suggest new opportunities and product enhancements
Coordinate with external agencies for planning and executing campaigns and initiatives
Coordinate online promotions to drive bookings, leads, and engagement across website and online platforms

d: To provide administrative and operational support to the Purchasing and Supply Chain Department by coordinating purchasing activities, processing purchase orders, maintaining procurement records, and following up with suppliers to ensure the timely availability of goods and materials required for business operations.
q: Diploma or Bachelor's Degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Procurement, Logistics, or a related field
Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in purchasing, procurement administration, supply chain, or a similar clerical role
Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, and familiarity with ERP or procurement systems is an advantage
Strong organizational and administrative skills, attention to detail, effective communication, follow-up skills, and the ability to manage multiple tasks efficiently
r: Assist in preparing, processing, and tracking purchase orders and purchase requests
Coordinate with suppliers to obtain quotations, confirm pricing, and follow up on delivery schedules
Maintain accurate and up-to-date purchasing records, supplier information, and procurement documentation
Monitor order status and delivery timelines to ensure the timely receipt of goods and materials
Coordinate with internal departments to confirm purchasing requirements and material availability
Support the preparation of purchasing reports and maintain procurement trackers
Assist in verifying supplier invoices, delivery notes, and other purchasing-related documents
Ensure purchasing activities comply with company policies and established procedures
Perform general administrative duties to support the efficient operation of the Purchasing and Supply Chain Department
